newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares close mixed, foreign buyers wait.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares close mixed, foreign buyers wait.

text.p: Russian shares closed mixed on Thursday, with foreign investors seen waiting but ready to snap up shares if prices fall.

"We might come off 10 percent before the buying kicks in, maybe more, but I see investors who would add to their portfolios if they had the opportunity," said Troika-Dialog senior salesman Terry Olin.
"We are adjusting to these new higher prices and at the same time we have seen a noticeable increase in political uncertainty."
The Russian Trading System index, which has climbed about 30 percent since mid-December, ticked down to 243.31 from 243.46 on a modest $18 million turnover for the entire market.
President Boris Yeltsin's health failed to impact on the market strongly, though news that his condition had "stabilised significantly" appeared after the market closed.
Mosenergo firmed for the day to $1.35 from $1.33 at Wednesday's close. LUKoil ticked up to $13.18 from $13.10. Surgutneftegaz prefs fell to $0.359 from $0.375.
"Generally, the market has continued to correct to a modest degree, though there were definitely some winners such as second-tier oil companies," said Oleg Tatkov, a trader at Renaissance Capital.
